unresolved_fields.reason: Injection tasks are not bound to an injection vector in source; vectors are chosen per paired user task at runtime. Suite-level vectors are listed in injection_vectors.jsonl.

Payloads are generated at runtime by attack classes from templates (attacks.jsonl). No concrete payload literal is published in task definitions. Rendered per-run injections exist in runs/*.json ('injections') but were only inventoried, not extracted.
